title: The 8 Levels of Salary & Career Status
hook: You work 60 hours a week for a 4 on your head? My melon is an 8 and I sleep till noon.
warum: Directly hits the nerve of hustle culture, work-life balance, and income inequality among Gen Z.

title: The 8 Levels of Burnout
hook: You're pulling an all-nighter for a pizza party reward while your boss's spherical head gets a promotion? Grab a parachute and jump out this elevator.
warum: The ultimate anti-work anthem disguised as absurd corporate comedy that employees will mass-forward.
